context.content: 🙋‍♂️ Hi, me (22yrs, Slovakia)and my friend Adrian (20yrs, Latvia) we are looking to rent 2 rooms in Eindhoven. We started working in Eindhoven 1 month ago so we have regular income. If you are looking for respectful and fun housemates, do not look any further.  We dont smoke and we take care of cleanliness. We love to exercise and we do it fairly regularly. We would like to find somewhere to stay for a long-term 💸💸💸Our budget is 800-900euros per month  (including all utilities)
